resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (resale housing inspection)
resale_co.issued_by: Willingboro Township Inspections Department (Department of Code Enforcement and Inspections)
resale_co.lead_time: The township advises scheduling the inspection within 30 days of the settlement date, because the CO is good for 30 days. All violations must be reinspected within 30 days of the first inspection.
requirements: Township housing inspection of the whole house, inside and out; all violations corrected before the CO is issued
Exterior: driveway and walks free of cracks or raised sections; lawn, trash and debris cleaned up; fence stable; screens in windows (May 1 to Oct 1)
Roof: no missing or broken shingles, maximum 2 layers; siding and gutters in repair; peeling paint scraped and repainted
House number: 6 inch numbers on the building
Interior: walls, ceilings and floors in good repair; working lights, outlets and switches with cover plates; windows open and stay up; no double-keyed deadbolts
Kitchen and bath: working burners, plumbing without leaks, exhaust fan or window, cabinets in good condition
Handrails on all staircases; garage conversions may need permits
Smoke and CO detectors within 10 feet of bedrooms; smoke alarms must be ten-year sealed battery type
Portable fire extinguisher (still listed on the township checklist): at least 2:A:10B:C, no more than 10 lbs, mounted within 10 ft of the kitchen and not more than 5 ft above the floor
Electric service panel with covers, working and labeled breakers; water heater with pressure relief pipe and bonding
Original heating certificate from a Willingboro-registered heating contractor (valid 30 days)
Private sewer lateral video inspection report from a master plumber showing no repairs needed (valid 6 months)
Open construction permits must be passed and closed; work done without permits must be permitted
Copy of a current property survey for all resales

fees.label: Resale housing inspection (includes one re-inspection within 30 days)
fees.quote: To start this transaction an application needs to be filled out along with a fee of $150.00 to cover the housing inspection which includes the first inspection and a re-inspection (if needed) as long as the re-inspection is done within 30 days from the first inspection date.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Resale Inspection Housing Application in the township's 'Moving' packet and submit it with the $150 fee to the Inspections Department, 1 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Willingboro. The form's office section lists check, cash or credit card. The Inspections page says resale/rental applications can also be submitted and paid online (the portal link is not shown on the page). The seller or agent can schedule the inspection; a lock box number lets the inspector enter. Give 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule or the fee is still charged.

evidence.quote: Did you know Willingboro Township requires all homes to be transferred or sold to have an inspection done by a Willingboro Township Housing Inspector.

Your Certificate of Occupancy (CO) will include a smoke detector certification, flood hazard letter, and certificate of housing code. We advise that your inspection be scheduled within 30 days of your settlement date (COs are good for 30 days).
If an appointment needs to be cancelled or rescheduled, we require 24-hour notice or initial fee will still be assessed to cover the scheduled inspection.

Below is a listing of the items to be inspected during your Resale/Rental Housing Inspection. All violations must be reinspected within 30 DAYS from the date of the initial inspection to avoid additional fees. All items must be corrected before a Certificate of Occupancy can be issued.
We also conduct housing, rental, resale, and zoning inspections.
We are now online! You can now apply and pay for Zoning, Resale/Rental, Dumpsters, Yard Sales, etc.

resale_co.notes: The 17-page 'Resale Application 2026' PDF is a scan with no text layer; it was read visually page by page. It contains the 'Moving????????' instructions, the Resale Inspection Housing Application ($150.00 fee; Inspections Department phone 609-877-2200 ext. 1214), the private sewer lateral instructions and report form, the MUA plumber list, an added assessment information sheet, a certified tax search request, the pre-inspection checklist (Department of Code Enforcement and Inspections, (609) 877-2200 ext. 1019), smoke detector placement sheets, and the registered heating contractor list (October 18, 2024). The checklist says rental properties must also be inspected annually (since January 2010). Other resale contacts in the directory: Stephanie Holmes (Housing Rental / Resales, ext 1021); Dennis Tunstall, Director, Inspections (ext 1019). Re-check 2026-10-06: the staff directory still lists Shaleen Bolling-Gonzalez, Housing / Rental / Resales, 609-877-2200 Ext 1033 (and Stephanie Holmes, ext 1021; Dennis Tunstall, Director, Inspections, ext 1019). The page markup now repeats each title (the name, then the title twice, then the phone), so the old one-line quote no longer matched; it was split into two verbatim pieces. The Resale Application 2026 and Certificate of Compliance 2026 PDFs are the same files (created April 8, 2026) and are still on the Inspection Forms page.

requirements: Smoke detector on each level including basements (not attics or crawl spaces)
Smoke detector and CO alarm outside each separate sleeping area and within 10 feet of bedrooms
Battery smoke alarms must be the ten-year sealed type (township checklist)

The township forms (2026 Certificate of Compliance and the resale checklist) still require a fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen, rated at least 2:A:10B:C and no more than 10 lbs, mounted with the manufacturer bracket not more than 5 ft above the floor

authorities.name: Willingboro Township Inspections Department

fees.label: Certificate of Compliance (smoke, CO alarms and fire extinguisher) inspection, when applied for separately
fees.quote: APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF COMPLIANCE THIS IS NOT A CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY ... $150.00 FEE

authorities.how_to_apply: For a sale, the township's resale Certificate of Occupancy includes the smoke detector certification, so the $150 resale housing inspection covers it. The township also posts a separate Application for Certificate of Compliance (smoke detectors, CO alarms, fire extinguisher; $150) inspected by a township inspector; submit it to the Inspections Department, 1 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, and give 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule or the fee is forfeited.

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA is Willingboro's fire code enforcing agency (registry code S), but the DCA smoke certificate portal flags Willingboro as smoke-certificate exempt and DCA's state-town list does not mark it 'SC', so the state does not issue these certificates here; the township Inspections Department does, as part of the resale CO or on the separate Certificate of Compliance form. The state fire directory still prints 'NJ Division of Fire Safety' as the smoke detector compliance contact; the township's own forms are preferred. The Certificate of Compliance form is a 2026 scan read visually; its $150.00 fee may be the same fee as the resale housing inspection rather than an extra charge (not stated). An older 2019 self-certification form (https://www.willingboronj.gov/DocumentCenter/View/338/Smoke-Company-Fire-Ext-Compliance-PDF) says smoke detector/CO certificates are valid for six months. The Willingboro Fire Department (398 Charleston Rd, 609-871-7476) handles emergency response.

other_items.label: Heating certificate
other_items.detail: Original heating system certificate from a heating contractor on the township registered list, valid 30 days, must be brought in to get the CO.

other_items.label: Private sewer lateral inspection
other_items.detail: Seller must hire a master plumber or utility contractor for a video inspection and certified Private Sewer Lateral Inspection Report (Ordinance 2021-13, Chapter 291). Repairs must be done before the CO; a satisfactory report is good for 6 months. Start once the home is listed, no later than the agreement of sale.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: Open construction permits are checked and must have final inspections; work done without permits must be permitted. The CO will not be issued until all permits are passed and closed out.

other_items.label: Property survey
other_items.detail: A copy of a current survey of the property must be submitted before a certificate can be issued for all resales.

other_items.label: Flood hazard letter
other_items.detail: The resale CO includes a flood hazard letter and certificate of housing code along with the smoke detector certification.

other_items.label: Certified tax search and added assessment
other_items.detail: Certified tax search request goes to the Tax Collector with a $10.00 fee (per the packet form); see the Tax Assessor about added assessments for improvements.

open_questions: Whether the $150 Certificate of Compliance is charged in addition to the $150 resale housing inspection, or only used when no resale CO is issued.
Direct link to the online resale/rental application portal (the Inspections page mentions it but shows no link).
